title: PresentationIconReference
description: References an icon used by enum value and boolean value presentations.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: prefer `kind: "class"` with a FontAwesome class list such as `fa-solid fa-check` for source-controlled descriptors. `blob` references an icon uploaded through the designer and is only valid in the runtime model layer. `dataUrl` embeds a base64 PNG/WebP image (`data:image/png;base64,...`). `path` references a root-relative application path such as `/images/icons/ok.svg`.

kind.description: Icon source kind. 'class' is a CSS class list; 'blob' is a designer-uploaded icon blob name (64 hex chars plus .png/.webp); 'dataUrl' is an inline base64 PNG/WebP data URL; 'path' is a root-relative application path.

value.description: Icon value matching kind: a CSS class list, blob name, data URL, or root-relative path.
